MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 42
   C. 30
   D. 21

3. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. 3/4

4. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

6. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 121

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 34
   C. 17
   D. 66

8. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 27.7

9. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 24.5
   C. 49
   D. 7

10. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 2/2

11. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 49

13. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 25
   D. 10

14. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 3
   C. 17
   D. 15

15. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 2

16. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.025
   D. 2.5

17. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

18. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 72
   C. 17
   D. 1

19. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

20. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 24
   D. 12

21. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 82

22. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 36

23. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

24. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
